title: Bias and Privacy Risk Sorter
description: Eight scenarios, four bins, and one distinction that is easy to state and hard to apply.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: AI-Customized Curriculum and Rolling Out New Agents

educational.audience: Club leaders evaluating an AI tool

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a short scenario describing an AI tool's behavior, the learner classifies it as an AI bias risk, an AI data privacy risk, both, or neither, and justifies the classification.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Drag each scenario into bias risk, privacy risk, both, or neither, and read the justification
pedagogical.assessment: A full pass of eight with the reason stated before each drop.
